questions.question: What does this repository do?
questions.standalone_question: What does this repository do?
questions.answer: This repository provides a full-stack FastAPI and Docker Compose template, complete with Python and TypeScript/Bun toolchains, database migration setups, automated testing workflows, pre-commit configurations, and contribution guidelines.

questions.question: What is the tech stack of this project?
questions.standalone_question: What is the tech stack of this project?
questions.answer:
The project uses the following technology stack based on the documentation:

- **Backend:**
  - [FastAPI](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com) for the Python backend API
  - [SQLModel](https://sqlmodel.tiangolo.com) for Python SQL database interactions (ORM)
  - [Pydantic](https://docs.pydantic.dev) for data validation and settings management
  - [PostgreSQL](https://www.postgresql.org) as the SQL database
- **Frontend:**
  - [React](https://react.dev)
  - TypeScript, hooks, [Vite](https://vitejs.dev), [TanStack Query](https://tanstack.com/query), and [TanStack Router](https://tanstack.com/router)
  - [Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com) and [shadcn/ui](https://ui.shadcn.com) for frontend components
  - Automatically generated frontend client and dark mode support
  - [Bun](https://bun.sh/) as the package manager and runtime for the frontend
- **Testing & Quality Assurance:**
  - [Playwright](https://playwright.dev) for end-to-end testing
  - [Pytest](https://pytest.org) for backend tests
- **Deployment & Infrastructure:**
  - [Docker Compose](https://www.docker.com) for local services and self-hosted deployment
  - [Traefik](https://traefik.io) as a reverse proxy with automatic HTTPS
  - [FastAPI Cloud](https://fastapicloud.com) for deployment
- **Authentication & Features:**
  - Secure password hashing by default and JWT (JSON Web Token) authentication
  - Email-based password recovery using [React Email](https://react.email)
  - [Mailpit](https://mailpit.axllent.org) for local email testing during development
  - GitHub Actions for CI/CD
